newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa gasoline prices rise by three cts/litre.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa gasoline prices rise by three cts/litre.

text.p: South Africa's Central Energy Fund said gasoline prices would rise by three cents per litre and diesel would rise by nine cents with effect from November 6. Illuminating paraffin would rise by two cents per litre.
The Central Energy Fund said factors contributing to the adjustments included higher international product prices and a deterioration in the rand exchange rate.
From November 6 the price of 93 octane gasoline in the Gauteng area around Johannesburg will be 213 cents. At the coast the price goes to 203.
The price of diesel in Gauteng will be 213 cents, and 203 cents on the coast, while illuminating paraffin goes to 136.43 cents in Gauteng. At the coast, illuminating paraffin will be 125.43.
